# RelayHub public reference

RelayHub is a managed connection service for application events, delivery workflows and live updates.
Use the product guides for outcomes and the versioned references for exact integration contracts.

## Versions

- [v1 reference](/versions/v1/llms.txt) — preview
- [legacy-v2 reference](/versions/legacy-v2/llms.txt) — legacy

## Capabilities

- **Managed integrations** (preview) — Connect trusted services and browser clients through one managed product surface. Limitations: Access is issued by an administrator; public signup is not part of this preview.
- **Webhook delivery** (preview) — Receive or send signed HTTP events with delivery status and retry behavior. Limitations: Provider-specific inbound signature adapters remain separate integrations.
- **Durable work** (preview) — Accept work for later processing when a receiver may be busy or offline. Limitations: Delivery is at least once; application effects must be idempotent.
- **Live updates** (preview) — Keep connected screens informed with low-latency application updates. Limitations: Live updates are for connected clients; use durable work for required processing.
- **Legacy v2 compatibility** (legacy) — Keep an existing v2 integration working while planning a move to v1. Limitations: Use v1 for new integrations; legacy compatibility is maintained only where documented.
- **Collaborative rooms** (planned) — Planned shared-room primitives for collaborative product experiences. Limitations: Do not use this capability in production examples until its release evidence exists.
